Dayton Dragons win again in Fort Wayne behind Colon, Hodgdon

  • Staff report
  • Aug 27, 2026
  • Aug 27, 2026 Updated 59 mins ago
  • Facebook
  • Twitter
  • WhatsApp

Dayton starting pitcher Edgar Colon struck out eight batters over five strong innings and reliever Trent Hodgdon recorded the final eight outs to earn the save as the Dragons defeated the Fort Wayne TinCaps 2-1 on Wednesday, Aug. 26 at Parkview Field in Fort Wayne.

The Dragons have won the first two games of the six-game series.

After a 61-minute rain delay before the first pitch, the Dragons took the lead in the second inning, getting back-to-back doubles from Eric Becker and Ryan McCrystal to make it 1-0.

In the third, Dayton’s Ty Doucette belted a long home run to right field to make it 2-0. The homer was Doucette’s third of the season and gave the Dragons the run total they would need to win the game.

Colon, a hard-throwing 20-year-old prospect from Puerto Rico who had thrown four no-hit innings in his last start, gave the Dragons five strong innings. He allowed one run in the third inning but kept the TinCaps from generating much momentum with a combination of a fastball that worked in the 96-97 mph range, a splitter, a slider and a change-up. He allowed just four hits and two walks over his five innings, notching two strikeouts in each of the first four innings.

Reliever Drew Pestka replaced Colon to start the sixth and worked a scoreless inning before the TinCaps threatened to tie the game against him in the seventh.

With runners at first and third and one out and Dayton leading 2-1, the Dragons brought in reliever Trent Hodgdon to replace Pestka, and Hodgdon induced an inning-ending double play ball to end the threat.

Hodgdon worked a scoreless eighth, working around a two-out error to hold the lead, and then tossed a perfect ninth inning for his 11th save. Colon (1-1) was credited with the win.

The Dragons had just five hits with three extra base hits — a homer by Doucette and doubles by Becker and McCrystal. Becker extended his hitting streak to eight straight games.

Up Next: The Dragons (23-31, 62-58) continue the six-game series in Fort Wayne at 7 p.m. Thursday with game three of the set against the TinCaps (23-31, 50-70). Kyle McCoy (4-5, 5.70) will start for the Dragons.
